headline: Sunny weekend family picks — 5–6 Sep
summary: Met Office Cardiff: Sat dry sunny ~20°C; Sun warmer ~24°C after any early drizzle. Hero: Fonmon Castle’s Great Crisp & Potato Festival (Sat, Vale ~30–40 min). Free/local: Roath Market (Sat), Riverside Market (Sun), Chapter mask workshop (Sun), Hubs homework club. Indie Collectives at WMC (Sat). Toddler show at New Theatre (Sun).

notices.title: Museum of Cardiff — currently closed
notices.detail: Museum of Cardiff (Old Library / The Hayes) is closed due to a leak; organisers say they will update when they know more. Do not plan a visit this weekend.

notices.title: Llanishen Reservoir — early close Sunday
notices.detail: Site closes at 16:00 on Sunday 6 Sep for staff training. Plan morning or early-afternoon visits.

notices.title: National Museum Cardiff opening change
notices.detail: Open 10:00–17:00 Sat and Sun this weekend. From Monday 7 Sep the museum closes on Mondays.

datedPicks.title: Great Crisp & Potato Festival
datedPicks.location: Fonmon Castle, Castle Road, Fonmon, Vale of Glamorgan CF62 3ZN
datedPicks.cost: Adult £15 · child £10 · under-3 free (+ £1 booking fee on paid tickets)
datedPicks.description: Wales’ first crisp & potato festival: free crisps on arrival, kids’ craft (design your own packet), blindfold tasting, crisp zones, potato food trailers, tribute acts, DJ, dinosaur trail and full castle/grounds entry. Dogs not permitted.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Unusual family day out with clear kids activities (crafts, dinosaur trail) and castle entry included — strong “if you do one thing” outdoor pick for a sunny Saturday.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Vale of Glamorgan near Barry — about 30–40 min drive from Cardiff (within DoNext coverage). Book via DigiTickets; dogs not allowed. SatNav to CF62 3ZN can stop short — follow brown tourism signs from the B4265, not via Fonmon village.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: paid tickets · book via DigiTickets (castle entry included)

datedPicks.title: Roath Farmers Market
datedPicks.location: Mackintosh Sports Club car park, Keppoch Street, Roath, Cardiff CF24 3JW
datedPicks.description: Weekly Roath community food market with local bakers, eggs, organic veg, cheese, coffee and street food. Easy free Saturday morning browse opposite The Gate.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Verified free local indie market with named traders listed for Sat 5 Sep — beats a tourist-staple default for a sunny morning.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Car park of Mackintosh Sports Club on Keppoch Street (opposite The Gate). Ends 13:00 — go early.

datedPicks.title: Indie Collectives market at WMC
datedPicks.description: Curated South Wales makers, bakers and small creatives trading inside WMC. Pair with a Bay walk.
datedPicks.statusNote: Confirm stall hours on the day at WMC. WMC what's-on calendar failed to load events in this check; date confirmed via It's On Cardiff + press citing Indie Collectives (organiser markets page still shows summer list).
datedPicks.whyPicked: Indoor Bay browse that pairs with a walk; local makers rather than a tourist staple.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Confirm stall hours on the day at WMC.

datedPicks.title: Homework Club — Ely and Caerau Hub
datedPicks.location: Ely and Caerau Hub, Cowbridge Road West, Ely, Cardiff CF5 5BQ
datedPicks.description: Weekly Saturday quiet study space with help using hub resources. Clear homework early, then enjoy the rest of a sunny weekend.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free community hub session with practical value — clear homework early, then enjoy the weekend.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Ely and Caerau Hub; free printing for schoolwork. Weekly Saturday slot. Note: hubs /hub-events/ index returned 404; this event page loaded.

datedPicks.title: Faces of Culture mask workshop
datedPicks.location: Chapter, Market Road, Canton, Cardiff CF5 1QE
datedPicks.cost: Free (no ticket CTA on organiser page; sibling Dream Inheritances workshops listed Free)
datedPicks.description: Drop-in mask-making for ages 7–13, led by Young Producers responding to the Dream Inheritances exhibition. Masks take about 20–30 minutes.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Free drop-in mask workshop with clear age fit (7–13) — distinctive local cultural session.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Ages 7–13 on organiser page. Masks ~20–30 mins; drop-in during the 2-hour session from 12:00.

datedPicks.title: Riverside Farmers Market
datedPicks.location: Fitzhamon Embankment, Cardiff CF11 6AN (opposite Principality Stadium)
datedPicks.description: Cardiff’s original Sunday farmers’ market along the Taff — local eggs, bread, veg, cheese, coffee and street food. Named traders listed for Sun 6 Sep.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Verified free Sunday local food market with trader list for 6 Sep — strong free/local composition pick for a warm afternoon.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Opposite Principality Stadium on Fitzhamon Embankment. Ends 14:00.

datedPicks.title: Fun For Little Ones — Tribute to Ms Rachel
datedPicks.cost: From £20 · under-12-months free on lap (babes-in-arms ticket)
datedPicks.description: Interactive toddler tribute show with sing-alongs, puppets and screen content. Book via New Theatre / Trafalgar Tickets.
datedPicks.sourceName: New Theatre Cardiff / Fun For Little Ones
datedPicks.whyPicked: Clear 0–4 age fit and an official ticket path — useful paid toddler option when free slots do not cover under-fives.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Under-12-months free on lap with babes-in-arms ticket from box office.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: paid tickets · book via Trafalgar / New Theatre

datedPicks.title: Techniquest — A-Mazing Summer (final day)
datedPicks.location: Techniquest, Stuart Street, Cardiff Bay CF10 5BW
datedPicks.description: Last day of A-Mazing Summer: Mirror Maze, sound exhibits, science theatre and hands-on zones. Indoor backup if Sunday morning starts damp.
datedPicks.whyPicked: Final day of the special programme — single tourist-staple backup only (Sat Techniquest dated pick dropped in favour of local markets).
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Last day; book ahead on Techniquest tickets.

evergreen.title: National Museum Cardiff
evergreen.description: Art, natural history and science galleries in the city centre. Under-16s must visit with an adult. Free day tickets recommended.

evergreen.title: St Fagans National Museum of History
evergreen.description: Historic buildings, open meadows and indoor galleries — dependable all-weather family day out west of the city. Food Festival is next weekend (12–13 Sep).

evergreen.title: Lisvane & Llanishen Reservoirs
evergreen.time: Open daily · café & trails (Sun 6 Sep closes 16:00)
evergreen.cost: Free to walk · paid water activities
evergreen.description: Circular paths, woodland story trail, visitor-centre café and optional watersports. Ideal sunny outdoor backup — note Sun 6 Sep early close at 16:00.

evergreen.title: Bute Park
evergreen.description: Central parkland beside Cardiff Castle — paths, play space and room to roam without booking. Perfect for the fine weekend forecast. Outdoor Cardiff lists no dated park events this weekend.
